description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Jax''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target unit's location.
description.text: Active: Jax dashes to the target unit's location.

description2.raw: If the target is an enemy and they are in range upon arrival, '''Jax''' deals physical damage to them.
description2.text: If the target is an enemy and they are in range upon arrival, Jax deals physical damage to them.

description3.raw: '''''Jax''' can cast any of his [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''
description3.text: Jax can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

leveling2.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
65 / 105 / 145 / 185 / 225 (+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * ''Leap Strike'' cannot be cast on [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. * If the target is an enemy champion, '''Jax''' will be ordered to [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] them after the dash ends. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the damage, including when [[File:Jax Empower.png|20xpx|border|link=Jax#Empower|An icon for Jax's ability Empower]] [[Jax#Empower|empowered]].
notes.text:
Leap Strike cannot be cast on structures.
If the target is an enemy champion, Jax will be ordered to basic attack them after the dash ends.
Spell shield will block the damage, including when empowered.
